newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat says Netanyahu has declared war.
newsitem.headline: Arafat says Netanyahu has declared war.

text.p: President Yasser Arafat was quoted on Thursday as saying measures imposed by Israel against the Palestinians since a twin suicide bombing amounted to a declaration of war, and warned that he was preparing accordingly.
"Netanyahu has declared war on us and we have to prepare for what will come. The situation is serious," Arafat was quoted as saying in an interview with the Israeli daily Yedioth Ahronoth.

After last week's bombing at an Israeli market by two Islamic militants killed 13 people, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called a halt to peace talks with the PLO and sealed off the West Bank and Gaza Strip, disrupting Palestinian trade and barring Arab workers from reaching jobs in the Jewish state.
On Monday, Israel's treasury froze the transfer of sales tax and customs duties it owed the Palestinians.

Israel has also rounded up scores of suspected militants in areas of the West Bank under its control and threatened to re-enter PLO-ruled areas if Arafat fails to do the same in territory he controls.
Crown Prince Hassan of Jordan failed in talks with Netanyahu on Wednesday to persuade Israel to end sanctions.
